title: ST depression–systolic pressure response coupling does not establish added cross-hospital CAD prediction
abstract: We tested whether exercise blood-pressure augmentation changes the diagnostic information in ST depression. A fixed interaction ST times (peak minus resting systolic pressure)/50 was added to ridge logistic models with flexible additive clinical and exercise predictors,including all interaction components and pressure augmentation. Hungarian development included293 patients;independent institutional Long Beach VA evaluation included136,106 with angiographic disease. Brier loss changed 0.230688 to 0.229550;gain +0.001138,1000 joint source-refit/target-bootstrap95%[-0.016623,+0.022329]. Source5-fold cross-validation worsened,and penalty sensitivity reversed external gain. No added benefit is established. Referral shift,missingness,protocol incompatibility and historical dataset exposure limit confirmation. Existing-data analysis,AI-authored,author self-checked and clean-rerun;not independent peer review.
